Messages.Author: Nick M
Messages.Body:
Hi,

When playing Tend the Flock and the chosen Baali has a Secure Haven,
will this cause the Methuselah to burn an additional pool?
I expect it does as Tend the Flock needs to target the Baali per card
text.

Does Blind Spot also burn a pool? (if the Methuselah playing the card
chooses a minion they control with Secure Haven)

Tend the Flock
Type: Master
Requires: Baali
Master.
Choose a ready, untapped, infernal Baali you control. Move 3 pool from
the bank to a younger infernal vampire in your uncontrolled region.

Secure Haven
Type: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master: unique location. Haven.
Put this card on a minion you control. This minion cannot be the
target of other Methuselahs' actions. Any Methuselah burns an
additional pool when playing master cards on (or that target) this
minion. Burn this card if this minion enters torpor. A minion may have
only one haven.

thanks

Nick M
